description: Source code for GDB stub implementation for x86 architecture in Zephyr RTOS, handling exceptions and debugging features.

methods.name: get_exception
methods.description: Maps hardware exception vectors to GDB exception codes.

methods.name: z_gdb_interrupt
methods.description: Handles GDB interrupt, saves register state, calls main loop, restores register state.

methods.name: arch_gdb_continue
methods.description: Clears trap flag to continue execution.

methods.name: arch_gdb_step
methods.description: Sets trap flag for single stepping.

methods.name: arch_gdb_reg_readall
methods.description: Reads all registers into a hex buffer.

methods.name: arch_gdb_reg_writeall
methods.description: Writes all registers from a hex buffer.

methods.name: arch_gdb_reg_readone
methods.description: Reads a single register into a hex string.

methods.name: arch_gdb_reg_writeone
methods.description: Writes a single register from a hex string.

methods.name: arch_gdb_init
methods.description: Initializes GDB stub, triggers breakpoint for GDB connection.
